evidence.title: Liquid metal — Animated metal shader effect

name: Liquid metal
summary: React component that wraps a button, chip or icon in an animated WebGL liquid-metal ring.
description: A real-time WebGL metal shader effect for React. It wraps a single child element, measures it and paints an animated metal ring on top while the child stays fully interactive. Options include three bundled palettes, auto light and dark theme, strength and paused controls, proximity reflection on neighbouring elements, custom border radius and sizing, and SSR support.
contains: React component wrapping a single button, chip or icon
real-time WebGL metal ring with optional proximity reflection on neighbouring elements (dark mode)
3 bundled palettes, each with tuned light and dark blocks
props: theme, strength, paused, custom border radius, sizing
SSR-safe; the child element stays fully interactive
